item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.

turns.text: make a video from this clip

dialog.agent: What would you like me to do with the clip—trim it, add subtitles, change its visual style, or something else?
dialog.user: make it vertical, show the man when he asks and the woman when she answers, each centred. keep all 10 seconds and the original sound, no captions.

dialog.agent:
You want a **9:16 vertical edit** that centres the man during his question and the woman during her answer, preserving all **10 seconds**, the original sound, and no captions.

I can’t make that exact edit with the connected Magic Hour tools: they offer generative video editing, but not precise cropping and speaker-based cuts. Generating a replacement could alter the people or dialogue.

In a video editor, set the canvas to 9:16, split at the speaker change, and reposition each segment to centre its speaker—leaving the original audio untouched.

turns.agent:
I tried, but Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits. No video was generated and no credits were spent.

I haven’t shortened the clip or changed your requested settings.

approvals.name: edit_video

style.prompt: Reframe this entire 10-second conversation clip into a vertical 9:16 portrait video. Show and centre the man while he asks his question; switch framing to show and centre the woman while she answers. Follow the actual speaker changes in the source. Use simple editorial cuts and crop/reposition only, keeping the active speaker's face and upper body comfortably framed. Preserve all 10 seconds in their original order and at original speed. Preserve the original sound and spoken dialogue exactly, continuously and in sync. No captions, subtitles, text, music, new dialogue, added shots or visual effects. Preserve the original people, appearances, scene and actions; change only framing.
